title: A framework for nurse scheduling problems based on prevention of bad-relationships
problem: Nurse scheduling is a complex problem that requires careful consideration of various factors, including skill heterogeneity, unfavourable relationship factors, and expenses.
contribution: This research proposes a framework for nurse scheduling that uses integer linear programming (ILP) to minimise unfavourable relationship factors and reduce expenses.
method: The framework uses integer linear programming (ILP).
results: The proposed model performs as expected and will be helpful for management.
